dedupe_keys.name: ministrstvo za infrastrukturo in energetiko electricity datasets

description: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zbirka podatkov o energetski bilanci obnovljivih virov energije in odp; Zbirka podatkov o elektroenergetski bilanci Republike Slovenije – letn; Zbirka podatkov o porabi električne energije končnih odjemalcev v Slov; Zbirka podatkov o proizvodnji električne energije na pragu elektrarn. Formats seen: HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
